Casting <arc/>Ascension or <arc/>Tempest Strike releases 3 tracking <arc/>Arc Projectiles that each deal up to <pve 200 /> <pvp [40] /> <arc/>Arc damage and apply <arc/>Jolt on Hit.

Applying <arc/>Jolt to enemies within 15? meters grants you a Damage Resist buff for 10 seconds that can stack 3 times.

Damage Resist granted with 1|2|3 <arc/>Jolt applications (Resist x2|x3|x4):
<pve 25% /> <pvp [5%] /> | <pve 40% /> <pvp [7.5%] /> | <pve 50% /> <pvp [10%] />

Applying <arc/>Jolt to multiple targets with a single activation of a <arc/>Jolt source still only counts as a single application.
